# Parked a second time, behind SEEN-101

The fix for the stale ticket path was written into this ticket's criteria and the advance was tried.
The gate refused at 0.46 against 0.6, judging the solution record against the pre-split ticket that
asked for three tools. The defect blocks the advance that would have fixed it, which is the same shape
as SEEN-086's bootstrap and the same shape as SEEN-100's: a gate cannot be repaired by the ticket it
is misjudging.

So the fix moves to SEEN-101 and the criterion added at record 10 is removed again. This is the second
time this ticket has parked to let the thing judging it be fixed first, and the second time the
measurement came from trying rather than from arguing.

Nothing is lost. The solution record is written and sits in the draft; when SEEN-101 delivers, this
ticket advances with the gate reading the ticket that actually exists.
